# iglu

# iglu: Interpreting data from Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)

The R package ‘iglu’ provides functions for outputting relevant metrics
for data collected from Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGM). For
reference, see [“Interpretation of continuous glucose monitoring data:
glycemic variability and quality of glycemic control.” Rodbard
(2009)](https://doi.org/10.1089/dia.2008.0132). For more information on
the package, see [package website](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/).
We also have a [GUI that requires no programming
experience](https://irinagain.shinyapps.io/shiny_iglu/) and mirrored
[Python version of iglu](https://github.com/IrinaStatsLab/iglu-py).

For short **tutorial on how to use the package**, see [Video tutorial on
working with CGM data in
iglu](https://www.birs.ca/events/2025/5-day-workshops/25w5474/videos/watch/202502260906-Gaynanova.html)
and corresponding
[slides](https://irinagain.github.io/Resources/SlidesWorkshop.pdf).

iglu comes with two example datasets: example_data_1_subject and
example_data_5_subject. These data are collected using Dexcom G4 CGM on
subjects with Type II diabetes. Each dataset follows the structure
iglu’s functions are designed around. Note that the 1 subject data is a
subset of the 5 subject data. See the examples below for loading and
using the data.

## Attribution

We are glad you found iglu useful. If you use it for computing CGM
metrics or visualizing CGM data, please cite the package appropriately,
depending on the features used.

**Original package paper**: most of the CGM metrics, time series and
lasagna plots, AGP

- Broll S, Urbanek J, Buchanan D, Chun E, Muschelli J, Punjabi N and
  Gaynanova I (2021). [Interpreting blood glucose data with R package
  iglu.](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0248560) *PLoS One*, Vol.
  16, No. 4, e0248560.

**Updated package paper**: for episode (event) detection, postprandial
metrics, built-in clustering and heatmap tools, new MAGE, and Python
version

- Chun E, Fernandes JN and Gaynanova I (2024) [An Update on the iglu
  Software for Interpreting Continuous Glucose Monitoring
  Data.](https://doi.org/10.1089/dia.2024.0154) *Diabetes Technology and
  Therapeutics,* Vol. 26, No. 12, 939-950.

**MAGE algorithm**: if you use MAGE, which is uniquely implemented and
validated against manual computation, we ask that you additionally cite

- Fernandes N, Nguyen N, Chun E, Punjabi N and Gaynanova I (2022)
  [Open-Source Algorithm to Calculate Mean Amplitude of Glycemic
  Excursions Using Short and Long Moving
  Averages.](https://doi.org/10.1177/19322968211061165) *Journal of
  Diabetes Science and Technology*, Vol. 16, No. 2, 576-577.

used/modified to help track divergence from future updates.

## Installation

The R package ‘iglu’ is available from CRAN, use the commands below to
install the most recent Github version.

``` r

# Plain installation
devtools::install_github("irinagain/iglu") # iglu package

# For installation with vignette
devtools::install_github("irinagain/iglu", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Example

``` r

library(iglu)
data(example_data_1_subject) # Load single subject data
## Plot data

# Use plot on dataframe with time and glucose values for time series plot
plot_glu(example_data_1_subject)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

``` r


# Summary statistics and some metrics
summary_glu(example_data_1_subject)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 7
#> # Groups:   id [1]
#>   id         Min. `1st Qu.` Median  Mean `3rd Qu.`  Max.
#>   <fct>     <dbl>     <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl>     <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 Subject 1    66        99    112  124.       143   276

in_range_percent(example_data_1_subject)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   id        in_range_63_140 in_range_70_180
#>   <fct>               <dbl>           <dbl>
#> 1 Subject 1            73.9            91.7

above_percent(example_data_1_subject, targets = c(80,140,200,250))
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   id        above_140 above_200 above_250 above_80
#>   <fct>         <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 Subject 1      26.1      3.40     0.377     99.3

j_index(example_data_1_subject)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 2
#>   id        J_index
#>   <fct>       <dbl>
#> 1 Subject 1    24.6

conga(example_data_1_subject)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 2
#>   id        CONGA
#>   <fct>     <dbl>
#> 1 Subject 1  37.0

# Load multiple subject data
data(example_data_5_subject)

plot_glu(example_data_5_subject, plottype = 'lasagna', datatype = 'average')
#> Warning: Removed 5 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
#> (`geom_tile()`).
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-3-2.png)

``` r


below_percent(example_data_5_subject, targets = c(80,170,260))
#> # A tibble: 5 × 4
#>   id        below_170 below_260 below_80
#>   <fct>         <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 Subject 1      89.3      99.7    0.583
#> 2 Subject 2      16.8      78.4    0    
#> 3 Subject 3      72.7      95.9    0.848
#> 4 Subject 4      91.0     100      1.69 
#> 5 Subject 5      54.6      90.1    1.03

mage(example_data_5_subject)
#> Gap found in data for subject id: Subject 2, that exceeds 12 hours.
#> # A tibble: 5 × 2
#> # Rowwise: 
#>   id         MAGE
#>   <fct>     <dbl>
#> 1 Subject 1  72.4
#> 2 Subject 2 118. 
#> 3 Subject 3 116. 
#> 4 Subject 4  70.9
#> 5 Subject 5 142.
```

## Shiny App

Shiny App can be accessed locally via

``` r

library(iglu)
iglu_shiny()
```

or globally at <https://irinagain.shinyapps.io/shiny_iglu/>. As new
functionality gets added, local version will be slightly ahead of the
global one.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`CGMS2DayByDay()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/CGMS2DayByDay.md)
  : Interpolate glucose value on an equally spaced grid from day to day
- [`above_percent()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/above_percent.md)
  : Calculate percentage of values above target thresholds
- [`active_percent()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/active_percent.md)
  : Calculate percentage of time CGM was active
- [`adrr()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/adrr.md) :
  Calculate average daily risk range (ADRR)
- [`agp()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/agp.md) : Display
  Ambulatory Glucose Profile (AGP) statistics for selected subject
- [`agp_metrics()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/agp_metrics.md)
  : Calculate metrics for the Ambulatory Glucose Profile (AGP)
- [`all_metrics()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/all_metrics.md)
  : Calculate all metrics in iglu
- [`auc()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/auc.md) :
  Calculate Area Under Curve AUC
- [`below_percent()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/below_percent.md)
  : Calculate percentage below targeted values
- [`calculate_sleep_wake()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/calculate_sleep_wake.md)
  : Calculate metrics for values inside and/or outside a specified time
  range.
- [`cogi()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/cogi.md) :
  Calculate Continuous Glucose Monitoring Index (COGI) values
- [`conga()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/conga.md) :
  Continuous Overall Net Glycemic Action (CONGA)
- [`cv_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/cv_glu.md) :
  Calculate Coefficient of Variation (CV) of glucose levels
- [`cv_measures()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/cv_measures.md)
  : Calculate Coefficient of Variation subtypes
- [`ea1c()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/ea1c.md) :
  Calculate eA1C
- [`epicalc_profile()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/epicalc_profile.md)
  : Display Episode Calculation statistics for selected subject
- [`episode_calculation()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/episode_calculation.md)
  : Calculates Hypo/Hyperglycemic episodes with summary statistics
- [`example_data_1_subject`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/example_data_1_subject.md)
  : Example CGM data for one subject with Type II diabetes
- [`example_data_5_subject`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/example_data_5_subject.md)
  : Example CGM data for 5 subjects with Type II diabetes
- [`example_data_hall`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/example_data_hall.md)
  : Example data from Hall et al. (2018)
- [`example_meals_hall`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/example_meals_hall.md)
  : Example mealtimes data from Hall et al. (2018)
- [`gmi()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/gmi.md) :
  Calculate GMI
- [`grade()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/grade.md) :
  Calculate mean GRADE score
- [`grade_eugly()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/grade_eugly.md)
  : Percentage of GRADE score attributable to target range
- [`grade_hyper()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/grade_hyper.md)
  : Percentage of GRADE score attributable to hyperglycemia
- [`grade_hypo()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/grade_hypo.md)
  : Percentage of GRADE score attributable to hypoglycemia
- [`gri()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/gri.md) :
  Calculate Glycemia Risk Index (GRI)
- [`gvp()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/gvp.md) :
  Calculate Glucose Variability Percentage (GVP)
- [`hbgi()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/hbgi.md) :
  Calculate High Blood Glucose Index (HBGI)
- [`hist_roc()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/hist_roc.md)
  : Plot histogram of Rate of Change values (ROC)
- [`hyper_index()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/hyper_index.md)
  : Calculate Hyperglycemia Index
- [`hypo_index()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/hypo_index.md)
  : Calculate Hypoglycemia Index
- [`igc()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/igc.md) :
  Calculate Index of Glycemic Control
- [`iglu_shiny()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/iglu_shiny.md)
  : Run IGLU Shiny App
- [`in_range_percent()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/in_range_percent.md)
  : Calculate percentage in targeted value ranges
- [`iqr_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/iqr_glu.md) :
  Calculate glucose level iqr
- [`j_index()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/j_index.md) :
  Calculate J-index
- [`lbgi()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/lbgi.md) :
  Calculate Low Blood Glucose Index (LBGI)
- [`m_value()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/m_value.md) :
  Calculate the M-value
- [`mad_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/mad_glu.md) :
  Calculate Median Absolute Deviation (MAD)
- [`mag()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/mag.md) :
  Calculate the Mean Absolute Glucose (MAG)
- [`mage()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/mage.md) :
  Calculate Mean Amplitude of Glycemic Excursions
- [`mage_ma_single()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/mage_ma_single.md)
  : Calculates Mean Amplitude of Glycemic Excursions (see "mage")
- [`meal_metrics()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/meal_metrics.md)
  : Calculate Meal Metrics
- [`mean_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/mean_glu.md)
  : Calculate mean glucose level
- [`median_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/median_glu.md)
  : Calculate median glucose level
- [`metrics_heatmap()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/metrics_heatmap.md)
  : Create a heatmap of metric values by subject based on hierarchical
  clustering order
- [`modd()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/modd.md) :
  Calculate mean difference between glucose values obtained at the same
  time of day (MODD)
- [`optimized_iglu_functions()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/optimized_iglu_functions.md)
  : Optimized Calculations of Time Dependent iglu Metrics
- [`pgs()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/pgs.md) :
  Calculate Personal Glycemic State (PGS)
- [`plot_agp()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/plot_agp.md)
  : Plot Ambulatory Glucose Profile (AGP) modal day
- [`plot_daily()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/plot_daily.md)
  : Plot daily glucose profiles
- [`plot_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/plot_glu.md)
  : Plot time series and lasagna plots of glucose measurements
- [`plot_lasagna()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/plot_lasagna.md)
  : Lasagna plot of glucose values for multiple subjects
- [`plot_lasagna_1subject()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/plot_lasagna_1subject.md)
  : Lasagna plot of glucose values for 1 subject aligned across times of
  day
- [`plot_meals()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/plot_meals.md)
  : Plot meal metrics visualization
- [`plot_ranges()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/plot_ranges.md)
  : Plot Time in Ranges as a bar plot
- [`plot_roc()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/plot_roc.md)
  : Plot time series of glucose colored by rate of change
- [`process_data()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/process_data.md)
  : Data Pre-Processor
- [`quantile_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/quantile_glu.md)
  : Calculate glucose level quantiles
- [`range_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/range_glu.md)
  : Calculate glucose level range
- [`read_raw_data()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/read_raw_data.md)
  : Read raw data from a variety of common sensors.
- [`roc()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/roc.md) :
  Calculate the Rate of Change at each time point (ROC)
- [`sd_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/sd_glu.md) :
  Calculate sd glucose level
- [`sd_measures()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/sd_measures.md)
  : Calculate SD subtypes
- [`sd_roc()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/sd_roc.md) :
  Calculate the standard deviation of the rate of change
- [`summary_glu()`](https://irinagain.github.io/iglu/reference/summary_glu.md)
  : Calculate summary glucose level
